scope: Current-status and contractual-right qualification of the same 6674/2324 cash-share-conversion candidate identified by the fixed Q3 title census; no new mechanism or outcome search.
asof_cutoff_rule: Record actual acquisition and reconciliation timestamps. These are current observations, never historical information availability or a sealed signal for a missed entry.
release_rule: Parent must pin the completed census checkpoint, verify every prior frozen member, then freeze this protocol before any live acquisition. A null checkpoint or missing protocol_freeze.json must block IO.
transport: native_public_sources.py; verified HTTPS; two workers; shared source lock
index_scope: M00 is the archived UI label for all material information. Preserve every returned original field and observed category/market, and reject wrong issuer/range or capped/ambiguous responses. Do not reuse the M11-only semantic filter.
adaptive_batch_rule: At most one further batch containing at most six saved requests, frozen after index readback and before those requests. Every saved failed response counts. Reuse hash-verified prior originals without a new request.
adaptive_priority: 6674 shareholder-meeting approval/rejection, proposal/meeting materials and any changes/cancellation of the cash conversion, including the latest controlling version.
Cash amount/adjustments, entitlement or last-trading/record dates, final versus provisional conversion date, outstanding approvals, termination/long-stop and cash-payment trigger.
Necessary buyer-side corroboration, current official trading status, or an executed-contract/meeting attachment exposed by the returned official material.
adaptive_route_rule: Only exact official HTTPS URLs/pointers demonstrated in frozen prior or newly archived responses. The six slots may fetch original MOPS documents, explicitly linked attachments, or official issuer/IR pages declared in that evidence; record parent archive/member/SHA plus exact pointer for each. Do not guess API routes, issuer domains, PDF names, or silently broaden the host allowlist. Followups are individually frozen, not automatically authorized by a link.

line_references: 249-250: M17 shareholder meeting notice and M18 meeting resolution labels
archived_route_evidence.meaning: Declared UI fields/categories, not proof that the issuer query returns all current material.

line_references: 2185-2195: company ID and category from UI
archived_route_evidence.meaning: Read as saved route evidence only. JavaScript is not executed; issuer-mode response semantics still require strict inspection.

required_contract_evidence: 6674 ordinary public-shareholder cash beneficiary and actual current tradability/rights-acquisition window; issuer-side and target-side announcements belong to one deal.
Controlling cash consideration and every adjustment/revision; 18.50 TWD from the Q3 source remains a sourced provisional term until current versions reconcile.
Outstanding shareholder/regulatory conditions, contract closing/termination/long-stop conditions, and exact evidence of satisfied versus still-pending approvals.
Entitlement, last-trading/book-closure/record-date mechanics; final or explicitly provisional conversion trigger and the applicable business-day payment rule/calendar.
Legal transaction form, relevant tax/withholding and fee rules; self-funding is a statement, not guaranteed payment or credit safety.
qualification_meaning: A fully described conditional contractual claim may be analyzed before future approval or actual payment. A future bank receipt is not required to start current research. Unseen critical contract terms remain unknown rather than assumed absent.
on_terms_qualified: Continue offline to a single-deal contractual clock and integer-share cash ledger with meaningful synthetic tests. Freeze any later valuation separately; this phase makes no quote requests or return calculations.
on_cancel_or_no_public_cash_right: Close the executable path for this deal with the controlling evidence; retain the project-level frontier and do not transform internal cancellations into failed public cash exits.
on_budget_or_material_evidence_gap: Record the exact unresolved rights/current-status/contract item and attempted official routes. Stop acquisition at the fixed eight-request ceiling; no automatic retry, arbitrary site search, manual user downloads or budget extension. Do not call a contract unobtainable merely because issuer-public-page pointers have not been inspected.
prospective_rule: Historical PIT completeness is not required for this current qualification, but no valid prospective signal until all necessary current inputs are reconciled and sealed before the chosen future entry cutoff. Missed dates remain gaps.
